name: fault_repair_recovery
description: Scenario I. A particle-load excursion on one CVD chamber: the load climbs far faster than the ordinary between-PM accumulation, particle-cluster defect intensity rises with it, the in-situ particle alarm crosses its threshold repeatedly, three complaints inside a week become a work order, and an unscheduled repair follows a human delay. Recovery is real but imperfect — the intervention quality is drawn, so a residual survives and 'did the repair work?' is a question with a nontrivial answer. Nothing here is configured except the excursion: the alarms, the escalation, the repair and the recovery are all what the fab's own generic response machinery did about it. The sequence is the signal.
